title: Deployment cart has no readiness probe
detail: No container in shop/cart declares a readinessProbe, so the Service routes traffic to pods that are still starting.

recommendation.action: Add an HTTP readiness probe on the service port.
recommendation.rationale: Traffic reaches a pod only once it can serve.
recommendation.risk: A wrong path keeps every pod out of the Service.

remediation.note: Add readinessProbe to the cart container.

title: StatefulSet orders-db sets no memory limit
detail: The orders-db container in shop/orders-db has no memory limit, so a leak can take memory from every pod on its node.

recommendation.action: Set a memory limit near the container's observed peak.
recommendation.rationale: A leak then restarts one pod instead of starving the node.
recommendation.risk: A limit below the working set restarts the database under load.

remediation.note: Add resources.limits.memory to the orders-db container.
